classes.example_reason: seat busy: seat is at its run cap
classes.meaning: A seat answered a capacity defer after admission.
classes.root_cause: Another job held what the call needed.

cause.root_cause: The seat or card the call needed was held by other work when it arrived: the seat was at its local run cap (`seat busy:`), a GPU lease of another class held the card (`gpu busy: held by ...`), or a media job waited for host RAM. It also holds the two text-lease holds filed elsewhere until 2026-11-12: the delegator's `local seat reserved (gpu lease ...)` (a text lease holds the only seat the call may use and no remote had room; filed `infrastructure`) and a node's `a text lease holds its card; it may take the call later` (filed `other`). A media call that named a node that did not answer the health probe (`no node that answered is called ...`, the node's own capacity defer; 8 rows, filed `other` before) is read here too. The harness defers rather than overload the card.
cause.evidence: pipeline/agenttask.go (seat busy, defer class capacity), pipeline/pipeline_gpu.go (gpu busy), ledger RefileStamped and DeferCode (the lease holds); 628 rows in 30 days as stamped: video 247, research 205, audio 109 (the agent pool at its cap, a media lease on the cards, host RAM), 93 more once the lease holds are read here (79 from infrastructure, 14 from other), and 8 more once `no node that answered is called ...` is read (video 5, audio 3)
cause.action: none: working as designed. Fewer deferrals need more free card time (keep a card free for media while text leases run) or a higher run cap on a box with room.

classes.meaning: The model ran and gave no usable answer.

cause.root_cause: The answer was cut at its completion token cap, so there was nothing usable to return: the vision lane's `vision output truncated` (117 rows) and an agent answer cut at the completion budget so the re-pack was skipped (about 94 rows, `output_truncated`). The cap is a setting of the seat or the call. The reasoning tier's `reasoning tier: low classify confidence ...` (the model's own confidence in a classify answer under the minimum, 3 rows, filed `other` before) is read here too, as is the browse door's `browse: blocked:` (the model or the loop reported no progress, 4 rows, filed `other` before; why the page could not be driven is not on the row).
cause.evidence: pipeline/pipeline_vision.go:315 and pipeline/agentlistcap.go:75; 221 rows in 30 days as stamped, 107 on one vision seat's questions, 228 once the classify confidence defers and the browse `blocked` rows are read (pipeline/pipeline_attempt.go, pipeline/browse.go)
cause.action: raise the vision lane's output cap for that seat, or ask for shorter answers; not investigated: why those answers run past the cap.

classes.meaning: A result failed the contract's own checks.

cause.root_cause: Mostly the research lane's own acceptance checks rejecting answers that were right or honest, not seats failing. Of the 357 rows (346 from research subtasks, whose checks the lane writes itself), 307 are those checks rejecting an answer that was right or honest: 256 fail a page-word tripwire that is graded against the loop's final prose and not against the structured digest, and 51 fail a derived `min_items` check on the first required array. Not every one of the 307 is shown to be a false rejection. 202 rows are established by comparing the digest to the page: 188 tripwire rows whose quotes and figures are found verbatim in the page, and 14 `min_items` rows on pages that were empty shells, login walls or placeholders. 105 rest on the seat's own statement that the page lacks the content (68 tripwire, 37 `min_items`) and were not checked against the page. The other 50 are 10 seat misses (it could not read or complete the page, found 1 of 3 items on a long report, returned an empty digest, did not echo an id, or left a status empty), 4 caller regexes that were over-escaped, 1 misfile (an audio row, see config) and 35 undetermined, because the ledger does not keep the answer or the kind of check. The class also reads 5 compose rows (error class `check_failed`: a composition's own runtime or layout checks failed, from one caller iterating on one composition; filed `other` before), with `bad_input` as the other reading since the composition is what the caller wrote.
cause.evidence: research/anchors.go AnchorCheck, graded by core.AcceptanceCheck.Eval and evalText; delegate/run.go (failed verification); 357 rows in 30 days as stamped, 361 once the compose `check_failed` rows are read here (5 added, the audio row left). By door: research 345 and the research CLI 1, agent_delegate 8, delegate CLI 2, audio CLI 1; by seat: a 9B-class seat on three nodes 211, a 35B seat 82, the agent-pool seat 58, a 27B seat 5; 264 fall on five days (2026-10-19, -20, -23, -24, -25). Check shapes, counted apart from the causes above (the 282 tripwire rows include 26 that are seat misses or undetermined, and the tripwire and `min_items` shapes share 6 rows): docanchor regex 282, derived `min_items:<field>:1` with 0 items 70, `min_items` with 1 item against a wanted 3 on agent_delegate 2, a caller regex naming a drive path 4, `contains:<hex>` 2, a caller regex of three alternatives 1, `nonempty:status` 1, audio dead_air 1. Why the tripwire is the suspect: none of the 282 anchor sets appears in the graded prose and 5 of 282 appear in the structured digest; the 13 digests with the lowest page overlap were read and none was about another document; widening the honest-absence words (delegate/absence.go HonestAbsence) rescues 10 of 282; the failure rate among research pages that reached a verdict is 7.0% (345 against 4,604 passed) and does not step down across delegator builds (3 to 14%). Of the tripwire first attempts retried on another node, 17 ended ok, 11 failed again and 2 ended in budget. Measured 2026-11-12 by rebuilding the register's class rule outside the binary and joining the rows to the delegation log
cause.action: the research acceptance is fixed in the same release (measured 2026-11-12 by an offline replay of the saved pages and answers through research.Build and delegate.EvalAcceptanceGraded, read-only; the original code reproduced every saved verdict, 356 fail and 4,622 pass). Three changes: a digest that quotes its page is excused from the page-word tripwire (delegate.DigestGrounded: one string of 60 or more characters, or two different ones of 15 or more, found in the contract's documents and not in the goal); research.Build derives a `nonempty:` check over the caller's required fields, any one of them filled, in place of `min_items:<first required array>:1`; and an HTML page under 150 characters of text is refused before dispatch as a skipped source (`error_kind` `empty_page`, no ledger row). Of the 356 failed rows with a job id, 167 now pass (125 tripwire failures by quoting the page, 42 item-count failures), 16 are refused as pages with no content and 173 still fail, 10 of them not research. Of the 4,622 passes, 4,513 still pass, 109 are refused as pages with no content and none fails. Rows already written keep their class, so the counts above and the register's 30-day count do not change; only rows written after the release are affected. Still open: the 173 (163 research rows: 67 digests that say the page lacks what was asked but also make a claim, 62 that hold strings of the page but under the grounding thresholds, 23 residual, 6 item-count rows silent in every required field, 3 where the seat could not read, 2 all-empty digests; plus the 10 that are not research), and recording the answer and the acceptance kind on the ledger row so the 35 undetermined rows can be settled. Known limit: a seat that says none for a page that holds the items is believed, now under a caller's own schema too; a caller who needs items writes `min_items:` in their own acceptance

classes.example_reason: capacity wait: no node had room

cause.root_cause: No node had room for the subtask before the call's deadline: 248 of 267 waited until the call's own deadline (not agent_placement_wait_sec), 259 for one node's agent pool alias.
cause.evidence: delegate/run_wait.go:436 and :442; 267 rows in 30 days, 259 on one pool alias
cause.action: none: working as designed. Reducing it needs more worker slots on the pool's node, or fewer research subtasks per call.

cause.root_cause: A limit the call carried ended the run before the agent finished: the call's own deadline (`call deadline reached`, `wall timeout after ... the caller's deadline`), or the step budget (`step budget exhausted`). Most are the caller's deadline, not a node ceiling. The agent loop's `agent loop: canceled` was filed here until 2026-11-12 and is now `canceled`; the browse door's `browse: budget:` (max_actions spent) is read here.
cause.evidence: core/calldeadline.go, pipeline/liveness.go:411, pipeline/agenttask.go:1295; 250 rows in 30 days as stamped, 241 from research subtasks; 17 of them are loop cancellations that ledger RefileStamped now reads as canceled
cause.action: give long research subtasks a longer call deadline or fewer subtasks per call; a run that ends on the step budget needs a larger max_steps.

cause.root_cause: A seat or node was set up so that it cannot serve the call: a seat's tool-call parser does not match its chat template, so a tool call came back as text (2 rows), or a node's configured data folder does not exist on that machine, so it could not create its pipeline-jobs folder for a dispatch (30 rows, one node; filed `dispatch_refused` until 2026-11-12), a node that has not opened the media-job door a call with input files needs (error class `no_node_configured`, 2 rows, filed `other`), or the audio QA could not measure the audio because ffmpeg or ffprobe is not installed (1 row, filed `failed_verification`).
cause.evidence: pipeline/agenttask.go:1303 and fleetnode/tasks.go:1031 (read by ledger RefileStamped); 2 rows in 30 days as stamped, 32 once the folder fault is read here, 35 once the media-job and audio QA rows are read (render/audio-qa.mjs, ledger RefileStamped and errClassCodes)
cause.action: set that seat's --tool-call-parser to the one its chat template needs; fix or remove the node's missing data folder (its `home`).

cause.root_cause: A node host did not answer on the network: a dial that timed out (`the connected party did not properly respond`) or a poll that never got an answer. It also holds a dispatch whose connection could not be made (`dial tcp`), a job whose polls were not answered (`N consecutive poll failures`), a node that rendered a job and whose output then could not be fetched (`rendered the job but fetching it failed`, a dropped connection; the render itself succeeded, so infrastructure is the other reading), and the 3 poll-deadline rows that ended on a last poll error (poll_deadline until 2026-11-12). Why the host did not answer (asleep, off, network) is not recorded on the row.
cause.evidence: delegate/run_remote.go; 3 rows in 30 days as stamped, 2 on one node, and 6 more once the rules above are read here (3 from other, 3 from poll_deadline)
cause.action: none from the harness: the node host or path is the fault; `local-offload doctor` shows which nodes answer now.

cause.root_cause: The class is the residue no rule names, a bundle of misfiled sentences and not one cause; it stays kind unknown on purpose. Of the 55 rows as stamped, 25 are read by the rules of 2026-11-12 that came first (a node's `a text lease holds its card; it may take the call later`, and the browse door's `BROWSER_UNAVAILABLE`, `DECISION_UNAVAILABLE`, `HOST_NOT_ALLOWED` and `budget` errors), which leaves 30. 27 of those 30 are lane refusals and transport faults whose sentences or error classes nobody had mapped, and each is now settled by a sentence or error-class rule: `no node that answered is called ...` (8, node_busy), a dispatch whose connection could not be made (1), `N consecutive poll failures` (1) and `rendered the job but fetching it failed` (1), all node_unreachable; error class `no_node_configured` (2, config); `media convert: convert: in and out are required` (1) and error class `lint_errors` (1), bad_input; `reasoning tier: low classify confidence ...` (3, abstention); the compose error class `check_failed` (5, failed_verification, with bad_input as the other reading, since the composition is what the caller wrote); and the browse door's `browse: blocked: the model or the loop reported no progress` (4, abstention: the loop ended with no usable answer; why the page could not be driven is not on the row). 3 rows are left: generate_svg rows with no reason, no reason code and no door, which cannot be traced.
cause.evidence: reasoncode.go DeferCode (the residue) and errClassCodes; 55 rows in 30 days as stamped (audio 18, browse 15, video 7, compose 6), 30 once the first rules are read, 3 once the rules above are read. Two further rows of those error classes are measurement runs, which the register leaves out
cause.action: the 3 rows with no reason need the writer to record one; why the browse door could not drive its page is a separate question the 4 `blocked` rows cannot answer. Not changed here: the other verifier wordings behind `reasoning tier: ...` stay in other until a row shows them.

classes.example_reason: poll budget spent: the node still owned the job
classes.meaning: A node owned the job and it did not finish inside the poll budget.
classes.root_cause: A job larger than the budget.

cause.root_cause: The class is for a node that answered and kept working past the allowance, and the 3 rows of the 30 days as stamped were not that: each is a research job that ran 681 to 978 s and ends `last poll error ... context deadline exceeded`, so the node stopped answering the delegator's 15 s poll requests while it owned the job. Two also show stale progress (128 s against a 60 s allowance, 922 s against a 79 s allowance) while other nodes completed normally in the same delegator session. They are filed `node_unreachable` here (ledger RefileStamped reads a poll deadline that carries a last poll error so), which leaves 0 in the window. Why the node went silent (asleep, off, network, hung) is not settled: no node-side log was available.
cause.evidence: delegate/run_remote.go runRemote (the poll loop and its 15 s poll request timeout) and delegate/reasoncode.go deferReasonCode (`poll deadline` is filed poll_deadline whatever follows it); 3 rows in 30 days as stamped, 0 once the last poll error is read as node_unreachable. One is the same incident as a node_unreachable row and carries `withdraw not confirmed: no answer within 5s`; one ran 877 s on a node whose normal p99 is 281 s and maximum 740 s; the third node's own health probes also timed out three times that day. The 20 older rows (2026-09-16 to -29) are pure budget shapes with no last poll error, and none has occurred since; they stay poll_deadline
cause.action: none for the filing (RefileStamped). For the node: `local-offload doctor` shows which nodes answer now; not investigated: why that node stopped answering. Not changed here: delegate/reasoncode.go deferReasonCode still stamps a poll deadline with a last poll error as poll_deadline when it writes the row (Record refiles it on the way to disk)

classes.meaning: The run went silent while the prompt was being processed.

cause.root_cause: not investigated: the rows say no progress in prefill past an allowance computed from the prompt size and the seat's rate; a prompt larger than the allowance or a wedged engine both read so
cause.evidence: agent/liveness.go; 0 rows in 30 days, 246 in the whole ledger (written before the stamp)
cause.action: not investigated: compare the prompt size of those rows with the seat's measured prefill rate
